questions.stem: A 4-month-old infant is scheduled for elective inguinal hernia repair under general anesthesia. Which of the following statements best describes key differences in pediatric anesthesia that influence anesthetic planning for this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Rocuronium is avoided due to risk of bradycardia

options.label: B
options.text: Sevoflurane is avoided due to pungency

options.label: C
options.text: Succinylcholine is preferred over non-depolarizing agents

options.label: D
options.text: The cricoid ring is the narrowest part of the infant airway
